ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal distribution with high-intensity (white) central regions (~45%) and low-intensity (black/dark grey) peripheral margins (~55%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity contiguous white patches located centrally on each lobe, surrounded by low-intensity black margins; numerous small-scale circular white-on-black and black-on-white rosette formations distributed across the surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central indentation with a wide-angle depression approximately 135 degrees relative to the lobe midlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations; a distinct jagged notch is visible on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex trajectory from the peduncle junction to the distal tips, terminating in irregular jagged protrusions.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of circular and ring-shaped high-contrast pixel clusters consistent with attachment scarring; concentrated clusters are visible in the lower dark regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Individual dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the white central patch of the left lobe and vertical streaks on the white patch of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-relief, high-intensity geometric clusters (barnacles) located on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique silhouette distortion on the lateral tips caused by dense barnacle colonization.
